item.description: Here you can choose whether or not the image should open in Lightbox. Note: if you select to open the image in Lightbox, url options below will be ignored.
item.label: Open in Lightbox

backgroundColor.description: Here you can define a custom color for the overlay
backgroundColor.label: Hover Overlay Color

use.description: If enabled, an overlay color and icon will be displayed when a visitors hovers over the image
use.label: Image Overlay

hoverIcon.description: Here you can define a custom icon for the overlay.
hoverIcon.label: Hover Icon Picker

iconColor.description: Here you can define a custom color for the overlay icon
iconColor.label: Overlay Icon Color

linkTarget.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window.
linkTarget.label: Image Link Target

linkUrl.description: If you would like your image to be a link, input your destination URL here. No link will be created if this field is left blank.
linkUrl.label: Image Link URL

item.description: Here you can choose the image alignment.
item.label: Image Alignment

forceFullwidth.description: When enabled, this will force your image to extend 100% of the width of the column it's in.
forceFullwidth.label: Force Fullwidth

showBottomSpace.description: Here you can choose whether or not the image should have a space below it.
showBottomSpace.label: Show Space Below The Image

module.description: Single picture with optional caption, link, and lightbox overlay.
module.name: divi/image
module.title: Image
